entries.name: Film grain
entries.what_it_does: Moving monochrome grain over the panel.
entries.when_not_to_use: Styles that already carry grain (noir, riso, cutout, watercolor).

entries.name: Paper grain
entries.what_it_does: Still paper tooth multiplied over the panel.
entries.when_to_use: Giving flat styles a printed feel.

entries.name: Halftone overlay
entries.what_it_does: A corner of angled dots fading across the frame.
entries.when_not_to_use: Styles that already have a dot screen.

entries.name: Vignette
entries.when_to_use: Focusing the eye on the centre.

entries.name: Letterbox
entries.what_it_does: Black bars grow in at top and bottom.
entries.when_not_to_use: Vertical formats with captions in the bar area.

entries.name: Frame border
entries.what_it_does: A thin inset border in a palette colour.
entries.when_to_use: A quoted document or photo feeling.
entries.when_not_to_use: Styles with their own border (comic, blueprint).

entries.name: Corner brackets
entries.what_it_does: Viewfinder brackets grow in at the four corners.

entries.name: Grid overlay
entries.what_it_does: A faint square grid over the panel.

entries.name: Dust and scratches
entries.what_it_does: A few specks and hairlines that change every few frames.

entries.name: VHS tracking
entries.what_it_does: A soft tracking band rolls down the frame.

entries.name: Flicker
entries.what_it_does: Small random brightness changes each frame.
entries.when_not_to_use: Long panels; see the photosensitivity rule (amount stays at or under 0.12).
